about: A JSON list of blocks, each with a `type`, drawn in order; broken ones are skipped. Numbers only from tools or the user.

blocks.for: A trend, a comparison, or parts of a whole.
blocks.use_when: line: trends. bar: periods or items; bars turn sideways for long labels or rankings; time stays upright. hbar: rankings, 2-5 named items. donut, pie: parts of a whole, 3-7 parts. stacked: parts of a total over time. area: growth that builds up. combo: two measures. 2-3 items on several metrics: a table, not a chart each.
blocks.fields: kind (as above). title. x: labels. series: [{name, data: numbers, null for a gap}], 1-3 (stacked, area: up to 6; pie, donut: 1). combo: first series bars, the rest lines (another unit gets its own axis). unit: "%", "₹Cr", "$M" or a word. tone: "change" colours one line by gain or loss. source: site name.

blocks.for: 2-4 headline numbers, change and trend.
blocks.use_when: The top of a report.
blocks.fields: items: [{label, value: number or short text, unit, change, change_unit: "%" | "pt", trend: 2-60 numbers}], ≤4.

blocks.for: A plan, day by day: timed stops with place, icon and note.
blocks.use_when: Itineraries, schedules, timed steps.
blocks.fields: title. groups ≤14: [{label, items ≤12: [{time, title, place, note, icon}]}]; only title required.

blocks.for: A strip of real photos with captions.
blocks.use_when: What a place or thing looks like.
blocks.fields: title. images 1-12: [{url, caption, source: site name}].

blocks.for: Options compared on the same attributes.
blocks.use_when: Phones, plans, hotels.
blocks.fields: columns ≤8. rows ≤30, a cell per column. highlight: {row: n} | {column: n} from 0, badged Best. caption.

blocks.for: A tinted box: a warning, a tip or the takeaway.
blocks.use_when: Warnings, tips, the verdict. One per reply.
blocks.fields: tone: info | tip | warn. title. text.

example.text: Pixel for photos; Nothing for price.

blocks.for: A small line naming the data's source.
blocks.use_when: Last block, for outside data.
blocks.fields: text. url (optional).

blocks.for: Rows: rank, icon or photo, title, subtitle, value.
blocks.use_when: Rankings, top picks, results.
blocks.fields: title. ranked: true numbers rows. items ≤12: [{title, subtitle, value, icon or image, run: sent on tap, or url}].

blocks.for: A value on a track to a goal; checkpoints ticked.
blocks.use_when: Savings, challenges, training.
blocks.fields: title. value. goal (> 0). unit. steps ≤6: [{label, at: number}].

blocks.for: A big count and the week, days ticked.
blocks.use_when: Daily habits.
blocks.fields: count. label, unit (default "Current streak", "days"). days: up to 7 [{label, date, done, today}].

blocks.for: A grid of cells shaded by value.
blocks.use_when: Sectors by quarter, habits by weekday.
blocks.fields: title. rows, cols: ≤12 labels each. values: a list per row. unit. scale: diverging (default with a value < 0) | sequential.

blocks.for: Flash cards: question front, answer (and photo) back.
blocks.use_when: Quizzes, revision.
blocks.fields: title. cards: [{front (≤120 chars), back (≤240), image}], 2-12.

blocks.for: Boxes joined by arrows, holding chips of what's in them.
blocks.use_when: Explainers, 4-8 stages. A chain only; branching graphs: a mermaid code block in the reply.
blocks.fields: id (for steps). title. direction: right | down. nodes 2-10: [{id, label, icon, note ≤280, holds: ≤10 chips (text ≤16 or {text, tone: accent})}]. groups ≤3: [{label, nodes: adjacent ids, count: 2-100}] frame a repeat.

blocks.for: A walkthrough with Back / Next.
blocks.use_when: After a flow: each step lights its node and changes the stage.
blocks.fields: title. for: a flow id. items 2-12: [{title, text ≤600, node, image, holds: {node id: chips}, send: true (packet from the last lit node), tick: 1-20 (rerun its group)}].

blocks.for: Slabs in light 3D, bottom first; Next pulls one out with its note.
blocks.use_when: A stack of layers or levels (network, model, atmosphere).
blocks.fields: title. caption. layers 2-12: [{id, label ≤24, tone: blue | amber | green | violet | accent | grey, note ≤280}].

blocks.for: Up to 3 buttons that send a message.
blocks.use_when: An obvious next step.
blocks.fields: items: [{label, run: the message}].

blocks.for: 2-8 colorful cover cards.
blocks.use_when: Activities or choices.
blocks.fields: items: [{title, subtitle?, icon?, image?, ask?: fills composer | run?: sends}]. No action = static card.

blocks.for: Items to tick; ticks are saved.
blocks.use_when: Packing lists, to-dos, steps.
blocks.fields: title. items: [text | {text, group}], ≤40. numbered: true for steps.

blocks.for: Sliders; results update live.
blocks.use_when: EMI, SIP, what-ifs; never do this maths in text.
blocks.fields: inputs ≤6: [{id, label, min, max, step, value, unit}]. outputs ≤6: [{label, formula, unit}]. formula: ids, numbers, + - * / ^ ( ) < > ==, min, max, round(x, n), abs, if(c, a, b), emi(p, rate%, years), sip(monthly, rate%, years), pct(part, whole), prepay_years|prepay_interest(p, rate%, years, yearly_extra), balance|principal_paid|interest_paid(p, rate%, years, after_years), sip_value(monthly, rate%, after_years). chart (live): {kind: line|area|bar, title, unit, x: {name, from, to, step: numbers or formulas, label: "Year {<x name>}"}, series ≤3: [{name, formula using x's name}]}.

blocks.for: A formula played over time, as dots or a line that draws itself.
blocks.use_when: A quantity over time; never this maths in text.
blocks.fields: title. t: {name, to, step, unit, speed}. inputs ≤4: calculator sliders, by name. values: {name: number}. view: {kind: dots | chart, per: amount a dot is, start, piles 1-3: [{name, formula (as calculator), adds}]}. unit. source.

blocks.for: Fields to fill; Send posts one message.
blocks.use_when: Before a big answer when two or more key choices are unknown: ask with ONE form, every field prefilled with your best guess, then build from the answer message. Not for a single yes/no (use actions).
blocks.fields: id, title. fields ≤12: {id, kind: select|radio|checkbox|slider|text, label, value, required, group: a heading shared with the fields after it}. options for select, radio, checkbox: text or {value, label, note}. slider: min, max, step, unit, ends: [left, right]. text: placeholder, multiline.

blocks.for: 2-3 small blocks side by side; they stack when narrow.
blocks.use_when: Two stats, a badge beside a link.
blocks.fields: children: 2-3 of stat, kpis, callout, text, badge, button, bar, link or image.

blocks.for: A titled card of blocks; collapsed: true folds it.
blocks.use_when: A table and its verdict; a card per day; details (collapsed).
blocks.fields: title. collapsed. children: any blocks but a section.

children.text: Fly to Coimbatore, then 3h by road.

blocks.for: 2-6 small blocks in two columns.
blocks.use_when: Stats, photos or bars.
blocks.fields: children: 2-6 small blocks.

blocks.for: 2-3 big blocks side by side; they stack when narrow.
blocks.use_when: Dashboards: a chart beside a table.
blocks.fields: children: 2-3 blocks (no section or columns).

blocks.for: 2-6 labelled tabs. Top level only.
blocks.use_when: A view per profile, stock or scenario.
blocks.fields: tabs: [{label (≤30 chars), children: any blocks but tabs}].

blocks.for: A tool's board (market_history, find_photos), placed by its id.
blocks.use_when: Dashboards around a tool's board.
blocks.fields: id from the tool's tag.

blocks.for: A title line between blocks.
blocks.use_when: Labelling a part of the reply.
blocks.fields: text.

blocks.for: A short paragraph.
blocks.use_when: A line of explanation in a section.
blocks.fields: text (plain; **bold** works).

blocks.for: One big number with a change chip.
blocks.use_when: A single figure, or two in a row.
blocks.fields: label, value, unit, change, change_unit (optional).

blocks.for: A thin line.
blocks.use_when: Separating parts of a section.
blocks.fields: none.

blocks.for: A small pill.
blocks.use_when: A status on its own or in a row.
blocks.fields: text. tone: good | warn.

blocks.for: A line of linked text.
blocks.use_when: A booking or official page.
blocks.fields: text. url: https.

blocks.for: One button.
blocks.use_when: A next step in a container.
blocks.fields: label. run: message, or url: https.

example.label: Plan day 2
example.run: Plan day 2 of my Ooty trip

blocks.for: One photo with a caption.
blocks.use_when: Inside a section or grid.
blocks.fields: url. caption (optional).

blocks.for: One progress bar.
blocks.use_when: Budget used, items packed.
blocks.fields: label, value, max (default 100), unit.
